parents.title: Insurance catalog
parents.source_text: Hierarchical categories, search, featured products, insurer profiles, plans, coverage summaries, product availability and assisted-versus-self-service presentation.

parents.title: Dynamic questionnaire
parents.source_text: Versioned product forms, conditional steps and fields, validation, drafts, resume, declarations, manual fallback, document requirements and localization.

parents.title: Customer and insured profiles
parents.source_text: Saved individuals, dependents, addresses, vehicles, property/devices and prior policies; relationship-specific reuse, consent and ownership.

parents.title: Official insurance inquiries
parents.source_text: Permitted plate/owner and policy-history inquiries, no-claim records, provenance, freshness, eligibility, failure handling and manual correction.

parents.title: Multi-insurer quotation
parents.source_text: Carrier eligibility, request fan-out, parallel results, deduplication, coverage normalization, quote expiration and insurer-specific pricing/rating.

parents.title: Comparison interface
parents.source_text: Comparable premiums, limits, exclusions, deductibles, eligible payment plans, customer/service information, sorting, filtering, badges and disclosed sponsored ranking.

parents.title: Coverages and riders
parents.source_text: Base limits, optional risks, dependencies, deductibles, exclusions, pricing effects and insurer/product-specific validation.

parents.title: Underwriting
parents.source_text: Risk declarations, eligibility checks, requests for evidence, manual review, acceptance/rejection and auditable underwriting decisions.

parents.title: Vehicle inspection
parents.source_text: Authorized self-photo/video and in-person inspections, booking, checklists, secure uploads, review, retakes, expiry and approval.

parents.title: Quote persistence
parents.source_text: Save/resume, eligible sharing with scoped expiring links, quote retrieval, expiry, reminders and abandoned-purchase recovery.

parents.title: Specialized product templates
parents.source_text: All product families listed below, each with its own risk schema, pricing inputs, plans, beneficiaries, documents, underwriting and servicing differences.

parents.title: Assisted quotations
parents.source_text: Complex commercial/group/cargo/engineering inquiries, lead assignment, callbacks, proposal versions, insurer negotiation and manual offer approval.

parents.title: Digital checkout
parents.source_text: Buyer/payer/policyholder/insured relationships, order review, declarations, consents, approvals, order creation and eligibility revalidation.

parents.title: Identity and documents
parents.source_text: Permitted identity verification, ownership/previous-policy/medical/property evidence, secure upload, malware handling, review and expiry.

parents.title: Online payments
parents.source_text: Provider setup, payment intent/attempt, redirect, authoritative server verification, duplicate callbacks, receipts, failure recovery and payment allocation.

parents.title: Installment purchasing
parents.source_text: Eligibility, financing provider, down payment, schedule, terms, guarantor/security requirements where applicable, acceptance and transparent total payable.

parents.title: Discounts and promotions
parents.source_text: Codes, insurer/product campaigns, limits, budget reservations, stacking, attribution, expiry, eligibility and abuse controls.

parents.title: Policy issuance
parents.source_text: Authorized carrier submission, automated/manual operations, underwriting dependencies, policy references, documents and failure remediation.

parents.title: Policy delivery
parents.source_text: Account/PDF access, authorized SMS/email links, optional physical delivery, courier integration and delivery tracking.

parents.title: Order tracking
parents.source_text: Separate order, payment, submission, underwriting, issuance and delivery status; customer-safe explanations, timelines and operational escalations.

parents.title: Finance operations
parents.source_text: Reconciliation, premium allocation, commissions, refunds, insurer settlements, payouts, accounting permissions and auditability.

parents.title: Policy vault
parents.source_text: Active/pending/expired/cancelled policies, documents, endorsements, coverage, insured subjects, authorized sharing and history.

parents.title: Renewals
parents.source_text: Expiry detection, reminders, prefilled applications, fresh quotes, insurer switching, group/fleet changes and renewal attribution.

parents.title: Installment servicing
parents.source_text: Schedules, balances, receipts, reminders, payment allocation, arrears, disputes and approved collection rules.

parents.title: Amendments and cancellation
parents.source_text: Corrections, endorsements, cancellation eligibility, insurer processing, effective dates, version history and refunds.

parents.title: Claims guidance
parents.source_text: Product/carrier procedures, required documents, service locations, support and escalation without claiming settlement authority.

parents.title: Digital claims intake
parents.source_text: Eligibility, incident form, parties, place/time, evidence, privacy, submission and claimant-facing tracking.

parents.title: Claim assessment
parents.source_text: Adjuster assignment, scheduling, inspection, loss estimate, approval/rejection, supplementary evidence and review rights.

parents.title: Claims payment
parents.source_text: Contract-authorized settlement, approved amount, beneficiary/bank verification, dual control, payment status and reconciliation.

parents.title: Customer support
parents.source_text: Tickets, live chat/callback integrations, complaints, attachments, consent-based account assistance, assignments, SLAs and escalation.

parents.title: Accounts and authentication
parents.source_text: Mobile OTP, optional approved alternatives, profile, sessions, organization switching, MFA for privileged roles, account recovery and consent.

parents.title: Wallets and credits
parents.source_text: Distinct cash/withdrawable, refund, commission and non-cash promotional balances, vouchers, expiry, permitted redemption and ledgers.

parents.title: Loyalty club
parents.source_text: Points, pending/confirmed/reversed accrual, missions, rewards, badges, games, prize draws, charitable redemption, expiry and fraud controls; regulated mechanics require review.

parents.title: Referrals
parents.source_text: Codes/links, invitation attribution, qualifying events, pending/reversed rewards, budgets, caps and anti-self-referral protections.

parents.title: Campaigns
parents.source_text: Banners, landing pages, segments, budgets, scheduling, targeting, experiments and insurer/product/channel restrictions.

parents.title: Seller/affiliate portal
parents.source_text: Onboarding, contracts, customer relationships, leads, quotes, assisted sales, teams, commissions, wallet, payouts, renewals, training and reporting.

parents.title: Corporate sales
parents.source_text: Commercial leads, employer accounts, group quotes, census, negotiated benefits, branches, approvals, billing and account teams.

parents.title: Content and SEO
parents.source_text: Original articles, insurer profiles, FAQs, product guides, searchable CMS, approvals, redirects, structured metadata and indexing control.

parents.title: Communications
parents.source_text: OTP, transactional notices, renewal/installment reminders, email/SMS/push, preferences, consent, templates, throttling and delivery events.

parents.title: Mobile and web-app experience
parents.source_text: Responsive web/PWA, secure uploads, installability, deep links and permission-aware notifications; native apps are a separate explicitly decided deliverable.

parents.title: Vehicle garage
parents.source_text: Multiple vehicles/motorcycles, ownership/authorization, policy links, deadlines, documents and lifecycle changes.

parents.title: Vehicle official inquiries
parents.source_text: Car/motorcycle fines, breakdowns, tolls, congestion/traffic charges, municipal charges, transfer taxes, license points/status, active plates/history, registration/ownership, inspection and vehicle history through authorized providers.

parents.title: Automotive payment center
parents.source_text: Supported fine/toll/tax/charge payments, fee disclosure, allocation, official receipt, pending settlement, duplicate protection and reconciliation.

parents.title: Automotive alerts
parents.source_text: Obligation reminders, inquiry alerts, paid SMS subscriptions, preference controls, expiry and subscription renewal.

parents.title: Maintenance marketplace
parents.source_text: Provider/location discovery, oil/service/car-wash/inspection/towing/battery/tire-repair bookings, availability, price, cancellation, fulfillment, commissions and complaints.

parents.title: Automotive parts commerce
parents.source_text: Sellers, compatible tires/batteries/oils/filters/accessories, catalog, inventory, cart, shipping, returns, refunds and seller settlement.

parents.title: Vehicle trading
parents.source_text: Price/valuation, listings, history checks, auctions, sale contracts, authorized secure-transaction support and debt settlement; each separately gated with authority and provider dependencies.

parents.title: Vehicle app utilities
parents.source_text: Digital document wallet, road-condition and technical-report provider utilities, freshness, mobile capabilities and no unsupported official claims.

parents.title: Adjacent financial referrals
parents.source_text: Authorized partner credit/investment referrals, eligibility, disclosures, consent, attribution and boundary between referral and direct regulated execution.

parents.title: Independent B2C sales mode
parents.source_text: Enable/disable direct individual discovery, quote and purchase behavior independently of B2B, with clear transition semantics.

parents.title: Independent B2B sales mode
parents.source_text: Enable/disable organization purchasing and configured partner-sale entry points independently of B2C.

parents.title: B2B subchannels
parents.source_text: Independent corporate, commercial, reseller/agency and B2B2C configuration; employee servicing is separate from new sales.

parents.title: Scoped availability
parents.source_text: Global/product/plan/carrier/organization/region/channel/customer/time configuration, dependencies, approvals, rollout, preview and rollback.

parents.title: Servicing continuity
parents.source_text: Sales shutdown preserves committed orders, permitted issuance, installments, policy access, claims, refunds and partner delivery; security quarantines use separate controls.

parents.title: Organization model
parents.source_text: Legal entities, branches, departments, cost centers, supplier/buyer/distributor relationships, memberships and tenant context.

parents.title: Organization authorization
parents.source_text: RBAC plus resource/relationship scopes, delegated administration, multi-organization users, invitations, revocation, access review and audit.

parents.title: Corporate approvals and billing
parents.source_text: Requester/approver/payer/policyholder separation, maker-checker, delegated limits, budgets, invoices, credit/prepay terms and purchase approvals.

parents.title: Bulk enrollment
parents.source_text: Employees/dependents/assets/fleets, imports, HR/API synchronization, row validation, previews, partial failure policy, approvals and effective-dated changes.

parents.title: B2C dashboard
parents.source_text: Policies, quotes/orders, payments/installments, renewals, insured assets, claims, documents, wallet/loyalty, notifications, support and settings.

parents.title: Corporate buyer dashboard
parents.source_text: Organization portfolio, branches/cost centers, group benefits, census/assets, approvals, bulk quotes, billing, renewals, contracts, reports and restricted claims information.

parents.title: Employee/beneficiary dashboard
parents.source_text: Own coverage, dependents, certificates, private claims, benefit information and optional separate personal purchases; employer cannot view unrelated personal policies.

parents.title: Seller/distributor dashboard
parents.source_text: Leads/CRM, quote/purchase, authorized customer portfolio, sales pipeline, renewals, team, commissions, withdrawals, training and performance.

parents.title: Carrier/supplier dashboard
parents.source_text: Own sales, incoming submissions, underwriting/issuance, policy portfolio, allowed product proposals, claims, settlements, API transactions and staff roles; optional API-only operation.

parents.title: Dashboard and admin configuration
parents.source_text: Menu/widget/action/report configuration for every dashboard, server-enforced permissions, platform super-admin and operational workbenches, localization and accessibility.

parents.title: Canonical purchase/event model
parents.source_text: Versioned stable business schemas for buyer, payer, policyholder, insured, coverage, financial references, distribution, permissions and event correlation.

parents.title: Company-specific adapters
parents.source_text: Separate versioned carrier/supplier adapters supporting heterogeneous REST/JSON, SOAP/XML and custom supported contracts.

parents.title: Post-purchase transmission
parents.source_text: Durably transmit required recipient-scoped data after authoritative commercial/payment confirmation; support approved B2B credit/invoice paths explicitly.

parents.title: Mapping and validation
parents.source_text: Request/response mapping, schemas, enums, dates, currency/units, error taxonomy, contract tests and safe transformation rules.

parents.title: Protocol and authentication support
parents.source_text: API keys, token/OAuth flows, signatures, certificates/mTLS and partner-specific requirements with secret references and rotation.

parents.title: Partner connection operations
parents.source_text: Sandbox/live separation, product/operation/channel availability, onboarding, approved endpoints, credentials, health, degraded and suspended modes.

parents.title: Reliable delivery and reconciliation
parents.source_text: Transactional outbox/inbox, at-least-once delivery, idempotency, bounded retry, dead letters, ambiguous-outcome handling, replay and reconciliation.

parents.title: Synchronous/asynchronous workflows
parents.source_text: Quote/reserve/submit/issue/status steps, verified callbacks, polling, cancellation/endorsement/claim flows and separate financial/insurance states.

parents.title: Integration testing and observability
parents.source_text: Contract simulators, failure injection, masked logs, traces, latency/error metrics, health and operator actions.

parents.title: Versioning and event routing
parents.source_text: Versioned mappings/contracts, compatibility, controlled rollout/rollback, recipient-specific projections, authorized exports/webhooks and delivery audit.

products.title: Motor third-party
products.source_text: Vehicle/owner and policy history, no-claim data, liability limits, term, penalties only from validated rules, installment eligibility.

products.title: Comprehensive motor / body
products.source_text: Vehicle value, insured perils, deductibles, accessories, inspection evidence, geographic and insurer conditions.

products.title: Motorcycle third-party
products.source_text: Motorcycle characteristics, ownership, prior policy, permitted usage and liability selections.

products.title: Fire / property
products.source_text: Property use/location, construction, building/contents values, inspection, perils and coverage relationships.

products.title: Earthquake coverage
products.source_text: Model as standalone or rider only where a carrier contract supports it; geography, insured values and exclusions.

products.title: Individual / family supplementary health
products.source_text: Members/dependents, ages, base coverage, declarations, benefit limits, network, waiting/eligibility rules and privacy.

products.title: Corporate / group health
products.source_text: Employer/census, dependents, benefits, enrollment windows, effective-dated changes, negotiations, billing and employee privacy.

products.title: Life / investment-linked life
products.source_text: Insured age, underwriting, beneficiaries, contributions, term and approved projections/disclosures without invented returns.

products.title: Pension / annuity
products.source_text: Contributions, duration, payout options, eligibility and approved benefit illustrations.

products.title: Travel
products.source_text: Destination, traveler age, trip dates/duration, plan/assistance limits and destination-specific eligibility.

products.title: Pilgrimage / Karbala
products.source_text: Special destination, traveler details, departure/duration, provider-specific plan and assistance rules.

products.title: Physicians professional liability
products.source_text: Specialty, professional credentials, practice, limits, prior claims and exclusions.

products.title: Elevator liability
products.source_text: Building, equipment, capacity/stops, maintenance/inspection evidence, operator and liability limits.

products.title: Sports
products.source_text: Sport/activity, participant identity, risk class, period, benefit and authorized issuer requirements.

products.title: Personal accident
products.source_text: Occupation/activity risk, benefits, insured parties and beneficiaries.

products.title: Mobile-device protection
products.source_text: Device model/identifier/value, age/condition, proof, inspection, limits and deductibles.

products.title: Electronic equipment
products.source_text: Equipment schedule, value, use/location, risk, maintenance and commercial underwriting.

products.title: Engineering
products.source_text: Project/type, insured values, period, site, contractors, technical evidence and assisted underwriting.

products.title: Cargo / transit
products.source_text: Cargo, values, route, transport, shipment period, coverage and supporting documents.

products.title: Commercial property / assets
products.source_text: Organization, asset schedules, valuations, multi-site risks, inspection and negotiated terms.

products.title: Other liability
products.source_text: Permitted professional/public/employer risks, insured operations, exposures, limits and assisted underwriting.

products.title: Dental implant
products.source_text: Specific eligible treatment/device/provider, benefit conditions, exclusions and sensitive health data handling.

products.title: War-related property coverage
products.source_text: Contract-defined eligible coverage/rider only; do not infer availability, legal approval or underwriting terms.

products.title: Fleet / other group insurance
products.source_text: Multiple insured vehicles/assets/people, group quotes, schedule changes, approval/billing and individual certificates when applicable.
